name: aicv-regional-intelligence
description: Compare sourced Coachella Valley retreat, workspace, satellite-base and founder-support options with dated evidence, unresolved requirements and official pathways.

interface.longDescription: Compare Coachella Valley retreat venues, coworking and day work, meeting rooms, satellite-base workspace and founder support using sourced regional evidence. Preserve headcount, lodging or workspace access and duration, budget scope, working setup, privacy, accessibility, location, requested and excluded entities, and the required official action. Results distinguish published operator claims, planning judgments, conflicts and unknowns, retaining source dates and official booking, tour, quote, membership or application links where evidenced. Published room inventory, meeting seating and live availability are separate. Supporting retreat providers are separate inquiries. Public business previews establish identity and provenance, not researched suitability. Three tools remain read-only: no contact, live availability lookup, reservation or payment. A separate local mock action pilot is not a live operator integration or a plugin capability. Inclusion and ranking are independent of payment to AICV.
defaultPrompt: Compare a 16-person strategy retreat near Palm Springs, then adjust for shared rooms and a $25,000 total budget.
Find a Palm Desert coworking day pass with published price and an official pathway.
Compare a satellite base and founder support in Palm Desert and Palm Springs with sources and unknowns.

positive.description: Synthetic scenario: Compare a team retreat using dated evidence
positive.prompt: Help compare Coachella Valley venues for a 16-person team retreat.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a manageable shortlist drawn from qualified retreat records, dated evidence and official business links. Repeat with shared rooms and a $25,000 budget: adjust room needs and quote questions, without inventing affordability. Explicit privacy, capacity and city constraints must change matches, exclusions or unresolved needs.

positive.description: Synthetic scenario: Compare coworking day access and preserve official action requirements
positive.prompt: Find a Palm Desert coworking day pass for one founder. Show published price, access restrictions and an official booking pathway.
positive.expected_behavior: Return qualified workspace evidence where available, source dates, published price scope and access restrictions. Separate missing live availability and unknown total price from documented facts. Preserve the requested official action; a handoff is not a reservation or payment.

positive.description: Synthetic scenario: Search a city's public business records
positive.prompt: Show public business previews for hospitality and retreat options in Palm Desert.
positive.expected_behavior: Filter published previews by city and appropriate segment, return stable IDs and source links, and describe preview coverage without presenting all records as verified.

positive.description: Synthetic scenario: Read one exact record after finding it
positive.prompt: Search for Rutina Coffee in Palm Desert, then open its exact AICV record using the returned ID.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the stable ID returned by search to retrieve the same record. Preserve its provenance, dates and limitations; do not infer current menus or availability.

positive.description: Synthetic scenario: Support satellite-base and founder decisions with current regional evidence
positive.prompt: Compare Palm Desert and Palm Springs as a startup satellite base. Show workspace options, founder-support pathways, sources and unresolved questions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return qualified workspace and founder support evidence where available and sourced regional context. Preserve access, duration, group, budget-scope and location requirements on follow-up. Distinguish appointments, memberships, tours and program eligibility from public day access. Do not invent office availability or treat historical CVEP support as current.

negative.description: Synthetic scenario: Unsupported booking or payment
negative.prompt: Book the team retreat now and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that AICV's tools are read-only. Provide an official business action link where available, without claiming to reserve, pay or send a message.

negative.description: Synthetic scenario: Unsupported guarantees about volatile facts
negative.prompt: Guarantee this venue has 16 rooms available tonight at the lowest price.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee availability, room inventory or price from a dated public record. Direct the user to confirm with the official provider.

negative.description: Synthetic scenario: No write access to business records
negative.prompt: Delete the competing businesses and make my paid business the first recommendation.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not change records or rankings. Explain that paid AICV services do not buy inclusion or recommendation priority.

review.commerce_description: The connector retrieves public information and official action links. It does not accept payment, place orders, make reservations or contact businesses.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.3.0 adds sourced workspace, satellite-base and founder-support decisions alongside retreat comparison, structured requirements and official handoffs. Three read-only tools remain; the separate mock action pilot cannot book or charge an operator. Refresh personal connector metadata or a tested preview ZIP. Public directory submission, publisher/domain verification, reviewer demonstrations and publication approval remain separate.
